description: Real-time collaboration on the Svelte 5 data grid: presence showing who is here and where their cursor is, and live edits where a change in one client lands in every other, over a pluggable transport. createCollaboration takes a user, a transport and onPeersChange and onRemoteEdit callbacks; broadcastChannelTransport syncs cursors and edits across browser tabs with no backend, and a WebSocket transport takes it across machines. Open the demo in two tabs to see it.

faq.question: How do cursors get shared?
faq.answer: onActiveCellChange sends the row id and column id through the transport; onPeersChange delivers every peer's position, and an effect locates the matching cell by its data-svgrid-row and data-col-id attributes to draw a coloured box with the peer's name over it.

faq.question: How are remote edits applied?
faq.answer: onCellValueChange broadcasts { rowId, columnId, value }; the receiving client's onRemoteEdit writes the value into its own data by row id and the cell flashes green through a shared cellClass callback.

faq.question: What does a WebSocket transport need to implement?
faq.answer: The same send and subscribe shape as broadcastChannelTransport, relaying messages to every other client through your server. The collaboration object does not care which transport carries them.
